adaptive
# range -128..128
# sum of line must not exceed the range!

# Bloom scanlines, light: adaptive scanlines for an exact 2x vertical scale. The gap
# between lines is 30% bright under dark pixels and 90% under bright ones.
# For the VERTICAL filter, with Scandoubler FX Off (the scaler draws the
# lines, not the core) and an integer 2x scale (288 -> 576). Needs the
# core built WITH ascal's adaptive filter (no MISTER_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE).
# First table: luma 0. Second: luma 255. Generated by tools/crt-beam-filters.py.
